jobs.prompt:
Environment for every shell/tool call in this job: export AOS_HOME=<HOME>/aos/tests/.sandbox/aos-home AOS_AGENT=agent:steward AOS_REGISTRY=<HOME>/aos/tests/.sandbox/aos-home/personal/kb-registry.yaml before running any `kb` command (or prefix each invocation with these three env vars inline).

# nightly-steward

Run the `wt-steward` skill over the commitments base — one base, always private, named in the registry as `commitments`. **One pass per night; never loop.**

Close out per the skill's own report section. `STEWARD: backlog clean.` is only the right output when all five signals AND the backstop are empty; a night with nothing overdue but a commitment stuck waiting still gets a report, never silence.
